text: a validation script that can enforce that menus and content is always reachable and isnt doing some jank ass wrap or missing a scroll container or what have you. the screens i showed you are good because im on the nose about it but the way i think about layout already is from a standpoint that everything is predetermined and has a fixed size even at runtime. thats just ideally how i think that building a ui is coherent. by that i mean for example i know a gutter is 420 px wide, and i know that percentages and flex have precise calculations against other constraints of style within the exact same set of nested elements, and even runtime data is going to load in a fixed component so ideally this is all verifiable at my breakpoint before i ever even open it to look at it
resolution: Added a V8-backed TS layout validation gate for hmsc-workspace-mock and fixed the concrete issues it caught: menu dropdown positioning is clamped against the fixed editor stage, clipped browser/journal/history/file-tree panels declare scroll reachability, and the Color Studio preview grid now fits its fixed container. Verification passed with tools/validate-hmsc-workspace-layout, tools/tsc-check hmsc-workspace-mock, and SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship hmsc-workspace-mock.
